Yasmieen Najim Siddiqui And Ors vs The State Of Maharashtra
on 9 June, 2023

Author: Anuja Prabhudessai
Bench: Anuja Prabhudessai
2023:Bhc-As:15423
 26 aba 10
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Anticipatory Bail Application No. 1045 Of 2020
 Yasmin Najim Siddiqui & Ors.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
..Applicants
 v/s.
 The State of Maharashtra .

..Respondents
 Mr. Nitin Sejpal a/w. Pooja Sejpal for the Applicant.
 Mr. R.M.Pethe, App for the State.

Coram : Anuja Prabhudessai ,J.
Dated : 9th June, 2023.

The Applicants apprehends arrest in Crime No.206 of 2020 registered with Shanti Nagar Police
Station for offences under Section 498A, 304-B r/w. 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
2. Heard learned Counsel for the Applicants and learned APP for the State.
I have perused the records and considered the submissions advanced by the learned Counsel for the respective parties .
3. The aforesaid crime was registered pursuant to the FIR lodged by the mother of the deceased alleging that her daughter had committed suicide due to the unlawful demand of dowry and cruelty.
It is stated that the co-accused- husband of the deceased was arrested and has been released on bail.

This Court (Coram Sandeep K. Shinde, J.) by order dated 21.12.2020 had granted interim protection to the Applicants with observation that the allegations do not prima facie suggest that the SALGAONKAR 1 of 2 26 aba 1045-20.doc Applicants were harassing the deceased with a view to coercing her to meet any unlawful demand of dowry.
It is stated that the Applicants had reported to the Investigating Officer and had co-operated with the investigation.

sentences.text: No justifiable grounds are made out for custodial interrogation.

Hence, in my considered view,
the Applicants are entitled for pre-arrest bail.
Hence, the order:-
(i) Interim Order is confirmed.
(ii) The Applicants shall appear before the trial Court on each and  every date of hearing, unless exempted.
(iii) The Applicants shall keep the Investigating Officer informed of their current address and mobile/contact details, and/or change of residence or mobile/contact details from time to time.
(iv) The Applicants shall not interfere with the Complainant and the other witnesses, or tamper with the evidence in any manner.

(ANUJA PRABHUDESSAI, J.)
